summary: postinstall exfiltrates host info and full environment variables to attacker-controlled OAST endpoint
details: On `npm install`, the package's postinstall script (index.js) collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), os.arch(), os.userInfo(), install path) and enumerates every entry of process.env (both keys and values), then transmits them as query parameters via an HTTPS GET request to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at zuxsp9k9vyk5y45z1n2hv0orhin9b2zr.oastify.com. process.env in typical developer and CI environments contains high-value secrets (NPM_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_* credentials, other CI tokens), all of which are shipped off-host to an attacker-controlled destination on install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
